findings.title: Possible hard-coded secret
findings.rationale: A credential-like value appears embedded in source.
findings.recommendation: Remove it, rotate it if real, and use approved secret management.

findings.title: Potential pointer-safety review
findings.rationale: Pointer-sensitive operation detected; this pattern does not prove a defect.
findings.recommendation: Trace pointer initialization/lifetime and check nullable pointers where appropriate.

findings.title: Potential indexed array access
findings.rationale: Indexed access detected; the index may need bounds validation.
findings.recommendation: Validate index ranges before access and test boundary cases.

findings.title: Potential unbounded string operation
findings.rationale: This API may not enforce destination capacity.
findings.recommendation: Use bounded operations and explicit size checks; test truncation and boundary behavior.

findings.title: Potential command injection surface
findings.rationale: Command execution can be unsafe if arguments contain untrusted input.
findings.recommendation: Avoid shell command construction; use safe argument APIs and validate inputs.

findings.title: Potential indexed array access
findings.rationale: Indexed access detected; the index may need bounds validation.
findings.recommendation: Validate index ranges before access and test boundary cases.

findings.evidence: int result = values[4];      // candidate out-of-bounds access
findings.rationale: Indexed access detected; the index may need bounds validation.
findings.recommendation: Validate index ranges before access and test boundary cases.

findings.title: Potential pointer-safety review
findings.rationale: Pointer-sensitive operation detected; this pattern does not prove a defect.
findings.recommendation: Trace pointer initialization/lifetime and check nullable pointers where appropriate.

findings.title: Resource cleanup review
findings.rationale: Resource acquisition detected; cleanup on all paths needs review.
findings.recommendation: Check success and error paths for matching cleanup and clear ownership.

guidance.title: # Input validation and bounds
guidance.excerpt:
# Input validation and bounds
Validate external input at trust boundaries. Check array indexes and buffer lengths before access. Test zero, minimum, maximum, and over-maximum values.

guidance.title: # Pointer and resource lifetime
guidance.excerpt:
# Pointer and resource lifetime
Define pointer ownership and lifetime. Check API return values and validate nullable pointers before dereference. Pair resource acquisition with cleanup on success and error paths.

guidance.title: # Defensive error handling
guidance.excerpt:
# Defensive error handling
Handle errors explicitly and do not ignore return codes from safety-relevant operations.

guidance.title: # Command execution
guidance.excerpt:
# Command execution
Avoid shell command construction with untrusted input. Prefer argument APIs, allowlists, and avoiding shell invocation where possible.
